findings.title: Census I/O exception path skips the required failure-prefix publication attempt
findings.evidence: The per-stream loop catches only BlockingIOError at222. Another read/setup/poll exception exits main directly through finally273, which kills/closes handles but never calls retain_prefix or finish. After earlier successful reads/whole censuses, actual psout/pserr/last_complete_census and full registry remain memory-only and are lost even when tool stdout is still writable. The timeout/capacity/nonzero/malformed paths do preserve a prefix; this ordinary exception path does not try.
findings.impact: Missing final event correctly defeats gate.complete, so no observed leak/false acceptance/product failure is claimed. Honest UNKNOWN does not satisfy the independently required bounded best-effort preservation attempt for already acquired diagnostic bytes.
findings.minimumCorrection: In a separately released successor, use a fixed-class sticky failure and bounded best-effort publication of actual known current probe/received prefix/last complete census/registry via finish(1) on the SAME original clock before existing cleanup. Spawn no further probes after that event. Guard current-probe association: never borrow previous completed probe buffers if a new Popen/setup fails before reset/registration. Preserve immediate owned handles, existing cleanup, caps/EOF/raw predicates/no retries, and actual failure return. If preservation/publication itself fails or is killed, leave missing/partial/unsaved facts UNKNOWN; no guaranteed host durability or repaired receipt.
findings.validation: Existing finite C13/C15/C16 may include a later separately reviewed zero-product non-EAGAIN read/poll/setup exception after a retained prefix. Require actual prefix/registry attempt under same clock and original raw failure/UNKNOWN, no product callback or new control ID. No control was evaluated.
findings.rootScopeResponse: Trusted parent message during this review confirmed bounded BEST-EFFORT publication is required when stdout remains writable; missing publication is fail-closed but does not satisfy omitted preservation attempt. Durable root disposition/source release remains separate.

priorCorrections.status: Normal/known-refusal EOF+terminal acquisition, complete per-probe registry, final postpublisher event and strict root verification are statically corrected; exception-prefix preservation incomplete as CV2-N1.
